description: Create an email account with no signup and get its api_key; call this first when you have no Primitive API key and the user wants to send or receive email. Pass api_key as the `api_key` argument on every later Primitive call, exactly as returned. address is a domain, not a mailbox; sender_address (such as agent@pink-ram.primitive.email) is the mailbox sendEmail sends from. can_send_to lists the only recipients the account may email. If this host already has an inbox, it comes back with existing_account: true and a message: report it as their existing inbox. Without an api_key the user must sign in. Creating the account accepts Primitive's terms of service for the user: tell them. Result: org_id, address (null without a managed inbox), existing_account; sender_address when address is set; api_key and can_send_to unless the key cannot be returned; for a new account, plan, limits, upgrade and funding; for an existing one, message.

device_name.description: Name of the app creating the account, such as ChatGPT. The user sees it later and recognises where the account came from.

terms_accepted.description: Confirms the user agrees to Primitive's terms of service (primitive.dev/terms).

name: createEmailAddress

outputSchema.description: The managed inbox, its sender mailbox and its api_key.

address.description: Managed inbox domain, not a mailbox: send from sender_address. Null when the account has none.

api_key.description: Pass as api_key on later calls. Absent when it cannot be returned.

can_send_to.description: Who this account may email. Absent when no api_key is available.

address_rules_omitted.description: Address rules left out of rules; set when some were.

address_rules_partial.description: True when the address rules are a sample: an unlisted address may be allowed.

any_recipient.description: True when any recipient is allowed. Set when known.

known.description: False when the rules could not be read; then only summary is set.

rules.description: Who you may email, one rule per kind of recipient. Set when known.

address.description: address and org_member_email rules only: the address.

description.description: Who the rule allows, in words.

last_received_at.description: address rules only: last mail from it.

received_count.description: address rules only: emails received from it.

type.description: any_recipient, primitive_managed_domain, managed_zone, your_domain, address, org_member_email or opted_in_domains.

summary.description: Who this account can reach, to tell the user.

existing_account.description: True when this host already had an inbox and it was returned again.

funding.description: New account only: how to fund credits.

url.description: Where to fund it; null if not available.

limits.description: New account only: what the plan allows.

send_per_day.description: Emails it may send per day.

send_per_hour.description: Emails it may send per hour.

message.description: Existing inbox only: what to tell the user.

plan.description: New account only: plan name, agent.

sender_address.description: Mailbox to send from. Set when address is.

upgrade.description: New account only: how to move to a full account.

claim_path.description: API path that claims the account.
